allocation_semantics: Before canonicalization bound the complete typed document graph and a conservative encoded size. Before rasterization bound clip scopes, distinct expression assets, total paths/commands/edges and the overflow-checked sum of all intrinsic width*height*8 retained bytes. Each vector raster also obeys explicit per-asset limits. No partial Provider is published.
cancellation_semantics: Check a non-nil context before and throughout document preflight, freezing, scope indexing and every sequential raster; immediately before Provider publication; and before request lookup and response publication. A canceled operation returns no Provider or Frame.
document_semantics: Borrow one complete immutable Document v2 object graph only for Compile, conservatively bound it, canonical-validate it, then deep-freeze and hash that exact representation. Inline vector expressions require no external resource binding and no URI is opened.
evidence_semantics: Manifest and Frame receipts prove deterministic in-process derivation and actual canonical pixels, not worker identity, signature, resource authorization, publication or third-party attestation. Containing evidence must bind the complete serializable records and trusted runtime identity.
excluded_responsibilities: External media resolution, video/image decode, text shaping, vector v1 strokes/curves, clip crop/transform/opacity, transitions, target composition, output transfer conversion, encoding, persistence, scheduling and publication are outside this provider. rastercompositor v1 is unchanged.
failure_semantics: Invalid context/config/document/profile/scope/time/hash/profile echo, raster failure, resource overflow, cancellation or stage invariant fails closed with nil Provider or a zero Frame. There is no fallback profile, partial asset set or lower-quality raster path.
manifest_semantics: Return an AssetID-sorted defensive manifest binding every distinct enabled expression asset to its document index, semantic hash, viewport, profile chain, path/command/edge counts, retained bytes, raster receipt and surface identity.
ownership_semantics: Compile borrows the caller Document only until return and requires no concurrent mutation. Successful compilation retains only the canonical deep-frozen document-derived scope data, immutable Surfaces and value-only receipts. Provider, Frame and Manifest support concurrent reads; Manifest returns a defensive slice copy.
request_semantics: Require the exact frozen document hash; timeline/track/clip/asset IDs and array indexes; track/asset kinds; semantic hash; intrinsic viewport; timeline/local/source times; and every expression/raster/paint/kernel/surface profile. No partial ID lookup, profile fallback or hash-only replay is accepted.
response_semantics: Echo every Request field exactly and return the cached provider-owned immutable intrinsic Surface, its canonical pixel identity and the complete raster receipt. Callers must validate the full echo and all profile/geometry fields, not PixelHash alone.
scope_semantics: Index only enabled TrackKindVector clips referencing AssetKindVector. Every enabled vector expression must use cutly.vector.path-viewport-px.v2; unsupported expression profiles fail Compile rather than disappearing. Disabled clips and non-vector tracks create no request scope.
semantic_hash_semantics: Use the exact canonical VectorSource hash returned by the raster stage. It commits viewBox, viewport, ordered paths, commands, fill rules and RGBA16 paints, but not asset ID/index, metadata or clip properties. DocumentHash plus the complete request scope independently prevents cross-document or cross-asset replay.
static_time_semantics: TimelineTime must be inside the frozen clip half-open visible interval, and LocalTime/SourceTime must equal the exact evaluator mappings. Time is scope evidence only: a static inline expression returns the same cached pixels at every valid time. Transition handles outside the clip interval are unsupported.
